parameters.query:
=SELECT 
    l.lead_id,
    l.address_line1,
    l.address_line2,
    l.town,
    l.pincode,
    l.visit_date,
    l.visit_time
FROM leads l
JOIN lead_assignment_history h ON l.lead_id = h.lead_id
WHERE l.lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Details"].json["query"]["lead_id"]}}'
  AND l.current_painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Details"].json["query"]["painter_id"]}}'
  AND l.current_status = 'ASSIGNED'
  AND h.painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Details"].json["query"]["painter_id"]}}'
  AND h.response_status = 'PENDING'
LIMIT 1;

=SELECT 
    l.lead_id,
    l.retailer_id,
    l.site_owner_name,
    l.site_owner_mobile,
    l.address_line1,
    l.address_line2,
    l.town,
    l.state,
    l.pincode,
    l.carpet_area,
    l.budget_range
FROM leads l
JOIN lead_assignment_history h ON l.lead_id = h.lead_id
WHERE l.lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
  AND l.current_painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["painter_id"]}}'
  AND l.current_status = 'ASSIGNED'
  AND h.painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["painter_id"]}}'
  AND h.response_status = 'PENDING'
LIMIT 1;

=UPDATE lead_assignment_history 
SET response_status = 'ACCEPTED',
    response_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
  AND painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["painter_id"]}}'
  AND response_status = 'PENDING'
RETURNING assignment_id;

=UPDATE leads 
SET current_status = 'ACCEPTED',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
RETURNING lead_id;

=INSERT INTO lead_status_history (
    lead_id,
    old_status,
    new_status,
    remarks
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}',
    'ASSIGNED',
    'ACCEPTED',
    'Accepted by matched painter'
) RETURNING status_history_id;

=INSERT INTO painter_performance (
    painter_id,
    allocated_sites,
    accepted_sites,
    open_leads,
    updated_at
) VALUES (
    '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["painter_id"]}}',
    1,
    1,
    1,
    NOW()
) ON CONFLICT (painter_id) DO UPDATE SET
    allocated_sites = painter_performance.allocated_sites + 1,
    accepted_sites = painter_performance.accepted_sites + 1,
    open_leads = painter_performance.open_leads + 1,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING painter_id;

=SELECT 
    l.lead_id,
    l.retailer_id,
    r.name AS retailer_name,
    r.mobile AS retailer_mobile,
    l.site_owner_name AS customer_name,
    l.site_owner_mobile AS customer_mobile,
    c.id AS customer_id,
    l.address_line1,
    COALESCE(l.address_line2, '') AS address_line2,
    l.town,
    l.state,
    l.pincode,
    TO_CHAR(l.visit_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS formatted_visit_date,
    TO_CHAR(l.visit_time, 'HH12:MI AM') AS formatted_visit_time,
    p.name AS painter_name,
    p.mobile AS painter_mobile
FROM leads l
JOIN users p ON l.current_painter_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN users r ON l.retailer_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN users c ON l.site_owner_mobile = c.mobile AND c.user_type = 'CUSTOMER'
WHERE l.lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - POST Response"].json["body"]["lead_id"]}}'
LIMIT 1;
